snippet.title: Velyr — The AI growth agent that ships the fix, not a to-do list
snippet.description:
Velyr reads your analytics every week, finds your biggest conversion leak, and writes the fix itself — a pull request on your GitHub repo or a change on your Shopify store.

You approve every change with one tap in Telegram. Nothing ships without your YES. Every deploy is watched for 48 hours — if bounce rates jump, Velyr proposes a one-tap revert.

Every fix comes with receipts: what the agent read, its confidence, and its blind spots. When the data is too thin, it skips the week instead of guessing.

Works with React, Next.js and Vite repos, and Shopify stores.

→ https://velyr.io
€49/mo · 14-day free trial · no credit card required

Built solo in Germany.
